title: Census Tracts
description: American Community Survey 2020–2024 5-year indicators for all 85,184 census tracts in the United States and Puerto Rico — typically 1,200–8,000 people, the geography most small-area social research is done at. The same four themed collections as block groups — [income](./tract-income/collection.json), [people](./tract-people/collection.json), [housing](./tract-housing/collection.json), [connectivity](./tract-connectivity/collection.json) — plus [wellbeing](./tract-wellbeing/collection.json), which carries the health-insurance, disability, nativity and income-by-race tables the Census Bureau does not publish for block groups. All five share the same geometry and `geoid` and join 1:1; tract margins of error are substantially narrower than block-group margins (median household income is NULL on 1.59% of tracts against 7.69% of block groups). [data.census.gov](https://data.census.gov/) is authoritative.
